summary: Onboarding clock is hold with 3 critical, 5 high, and 2 warning finding(s).

findings.message: The proposed submission clock starts before every accepted team is workspace-ready.
findings.impact: The system should start or resume the challenge window only after equivalent access is verified.
findings.remediation: Move the clock start to the latest ready timestamp plus any published buffer.

findings.message: team-gamma has no ready workspace timestamp.
findings.impact: The submission clock should not begin for any accepted team until every workspace is usable.
findings.remediation: Provision the workspace and record the ready timestamp before starting the clock.

findings.message: team-beta became workspace-ready after the proposed submission clock start.
findings.impact: Late workspace readiness silently reduces that team's competition window.
findings.remediation: Delay the submission clock until this workspace and all peers are ready.

findings.message: team-beta has less compute quota than the published onboarding baseline.
findings.impact: Solver teams need equivalent budget to run starter notebooks and benchmarks.
findings.remediation: Top up compute quota before opening the submission clock.

findings.message: team-beta is missing one or more required tools before clock start.
findings.impact: Unequal tool access creates avoidable solver disadvantage.
findings.remediation: Grant all required tools before starting or resuming the submission clock.

findings.message: team-beta received a starter kit checksum that does not match the canonical kit.
findings.impact: Teams must start from equivalent starter notebooks, fixtures, and instructions.
findings.remediation: Re-issue the canonical starter kit and refresh the checksum evidence.

findings.message: team-beta cannot see every required support channel.
findings.impact: Support-channel asymmetry changes how quickly teams can resolve setup blockers.
findings.remediation: Add the team to all required support channels before clock start.

findings.message: team-beta received template workspace-template-2026.05 instead of workspace-template-2026.06.
findings.impact: Different starter templates can change solver workload and reproducibility.
findings.remediation: Rebuild the workspace from the canonical challenge template.

findings.message: team-beta still had a setup blocker when the proposed clock started.
findings.impact: Clock fairness is weaker if setup support starts after the challenge window begins.
findings.remediation: Pause or delay the clock until setup blockers receive an actionable response.

findings.message: team-alpha has extra tool access not listed in the canonical onboarding plan.
findings.impact: Extra tools may be fine, but they should be explicitly approved or granted to all teams.
findings.remediation: Approve the extra tools as non-material or normalize tool access across teams.
